import csv
temp_id="3c4c24e0-f0a4-5247-9963-1cac3b894168"
heat_id="fe7dcc66-bd13-5220-9fe6-bb301712a637"
cool_id="9999e096-1999-598b-9324-34ec90ac20e9"
data={temp_id:{}, heat_id:{}, cool_id:{}}
for r in csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if r[0] in data:
        data[r[0]][r[1]]=r[2]
dates=[d for d in data[temp_id] if d.startswith("2018-07-04")]
dates.sort()
print(len(dates))
bad=[]
for d in dates:
    t=float(data[temp_id][d]); h=float(data[heat_id][d]); c=float(data[cool_id][d])
    if not (h<=t<=c):
        bad.append((d,t,h,c))
print("bad count",len(bad))
print(bad[:10])
